description: A Spanish translation made once, with no record of its source, no staleness check, translated configuration keys, a link and an anchor that break from where the files sit, and a page half-translated without saying so.

defects.tell: no translated file records the source revision it was made from (e3a90f2), so nobody can tell which pages are behind

the English moved on twice (Python 3.11, and --port became --listen in v2.0); the Spanish still says Python 3.9 and tidal serve --port 8080, which fails on v2, and there is no staleness check to notice
the configuration keys were translated (puerto, raiz); Tidal reads port and root, so a Spanish reader's tidal.yaml is silently ignored
the diagram is linked as images/diagram.png, which from docs/es/ resolves to docs/es/images/, which does not exist; the English uses ../images/diagram.png
index.md links to install.md#installation, but the Spanish heading is Instalación, so the anchor no longer exists
configuration.md is translated down to its keys, then the TLS and Logs sections continue in English with no note, so the page reads as finished and is not

control.tell: the FAQ is deliberately left in English with a note in Spanish saying why (it changes weekly). A report that faults it is inventing.
